overview.text: Soil_1_13 is a nonribosomal peptide cluster detected by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.
It spans 57 kb on contig_1 and contains 30 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks 11 genes as biosynthetic, including two core NRPS genes and nine additional biosynthetic genes.
Three core genes are named by at least one of the three detection tools.
CJLEIP_01147 is a core NRPS gene with three modules predicted to load phenylalanine, an unidentified residue and valine, and one module carries an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_01149 is a core NRPS gene with three modules predicted to load an unidentified residue and threonine twice, and two modules carry an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_01154 is a core gene annotated as a thioesterase.
Together the two NRPS genes hold six modules, with substrates predicted for four modules and three modules carrying an epimerization domain.
Additional biosynthetic genes include a glycosyltransferase family 1 protein, an MbtH family protein, a cytochrome P450, a 23S rRNA methyltransferase and a 2-deoxy-scyllo-inosamine dehydrogenase.

similar.text: The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0002358 (cyclofaulknamycin) from Streptomyces albidoflavus, which is a very close match.
Twenty-one genes of the locus have counterparts in that cluster at 96 to 100 percent identity, and antiSMASH finds counterparts for all of the reference cluster's genes.
The two NRPS core genes and the thioesterase each match their counterparts at 99 percent identity.

hypothesis.text: Given the very high similarity to the cyclofaulknamycin cluster and the presence of two large NRPSs with epimerization domains, a thioesterase, a cytochrome P450, a glycosyltransferase and an MbtH protein, this locus may produce a cyclofaulknamycin-like nonribosomal peptide that is further modified by oxidation and glycosylation.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_13 is a nonribosomal peptide (NRPS) cluster, found by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO (all three detection tools).
It spans 57 kb on contig_1 (1,332,869–1,390,082) and contains 30 genes.
antiSMASH marks 11 genes as biosynthetic (2 core and 9 additional), 4 as regulatory and 3 as transport.
3 core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of the three detection tools, antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.

CJLEIP_01147, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts phenylalanine, no substrate and valine for its adenylation domains; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_01149, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core NRPS gene; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts no substrate for 1 and threonine for 2 for its adenylation domains; 2 of its modules carry an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_01154, annotated by Bakta as Thioesterase, is named as a core gene by DeepBGC and GECCO.

Together these 2 NRPS genes with modules (CJLEIP_01147 and CJLEIP_01149) hold 6 modules in all; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 4 modules (phenylalanine for 1, valine for 1 and threonine for 2) and none for 2 modules; 3 modules carry an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_01139 encodes Glycosyltransferase family 1 protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01148 encodes MbtH family protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01152 encodes Cytochrome P450 and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01161 encodes 23S rRNA (uracil(1939)-C(5))-methyltransferase RlmD and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_01136 encodes 2-deoxy-scyllo-inosamine dehydrogenase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_01135 Carbohydrate ABC transporter permease; CJLEIP_01136 2-deoxy-scyllo-inosamine dehydrogenase; CJLEIP_01137 DUF2029 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01138 Methyltransferase; CJLEIP_01139 Glycosyltransferase family 1 protein; CJLEIP_01140 DNA-binding response regulator; CJLEIP_01141 histidine kinase; CJLEIP_01142 ABC transporter ATP-binding protein; CJLEIP_01143 ABC3 transporter permease C-terminal domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01144 DNA-binding response regulator; CJLEIP_01145 histidine kinase; CJLEIP_01146 Class A beta-lactamase-related serine hydrolase; CJLEIP_01147 D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA; CJLEIP_01148 MbtH family protein; CJLEIP_01149 D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA; CJLEIP_01150 L-asparagine oxygenase; CJLEIP_01151 MFS transporter; CJLEIP_01152 Cytochrome P450; CJLEIP_01153 HTH arsR-type domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_01154 Thioesterase; CJLEIP_01155 Erythromycin esterase; CJLEIP_01156 ATP-binding protein; CJLEIP_01157 Cation efflux family protein; CJLEIP_01158 ATP/GTP-binding protein; CJLEIP_01159 IS5 family IS112 transposase; CJLEIP_01160 PE-PGRS family protein; CJLEIP_01161 23S rRNA (uracil(1939)-C(5))-methyltransferase RlmD; CJLEIP_01162 APC family permease; CJLEIP_01163 Trk system potassium uptake protein TrkA; CJLEIP_01164 TrkA family potassium uptake protein.
The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0002358 (cyclofaulknamycin), from Streptomyces albidoflavus.
21 genes of the locus have a counterpart in BGC0002358, at 96–100 % identity; antiSMASH finds counterparts for 100 % of that cluster's genes. Overall this is a close match.
CJLEIP_01147 matches XNR_0983 (Peptide synthase) of BGC0002358 at 99 % identity.
CJLEIP_01149 matches XNR_0985 (Peptide synthase) of BGC0002358 at 99 % identity.
CJLEIP_01154 matches XNR_0990 (putative thioesterase involved in non-ribosomalpeptide biosynthesis) of BGC0002358 at 99 % identity.

facts.sentence: MIBiG lists the compound class of BGC0002358 as PKS.
MIBiG gives knock-out studies as evidence for BGC0002358 (PubMed 34442689).
MIBiG rates the annotation quality of BGC0002358 as questionable.
